objective: Complete readablePaths confinement across every read-like agent tool as one source-and-test repair. Direct read must refuse out-of-scope files without revealing bytes. list_files at the territory root must walk the territory but return only files for which readAdmitted(file) is true; an explicitly non-root out-of-scope list base must return a structured refusal without protected filenames. search at the territory root must inspect only files for which readAdmitted(file) is true; an explicitly non-root out-of-scope search base must return a structured refusal without protected matching lines. Preserve unrestricted behavior when readablePaths is absent. The prior cloud candidate failed because it admitted the empty root but did not filter each walked file; do not repeat that failure.

complete-readable-scope.description: The coupled source and test prove exact-file and directory admission, root-level per-file filtering for list and search, structured explicit-base refusals with no protected bytes or names, unrestricted compatibility, and a green full suite.

constraints: Keep confinement logic inside src/agent-tools.mjs and create test/readable-paths-complete.test.mjs in the same mission.
For list_files and search, allow the empty relative root as a traversal base but filter every returned or inspected file through readAdmitted.
For a non-root requested base, refuse unless the base itself is readAdmitted.
Test exact-file admission as well as directory-descendant admission.
Test that protected filenames, file bytes, and matching lines never appear in filtered results or refusals.
Preserve unrestricted behavior when readablePaths is empty.
Do not move readAdmitted into the module-level walk function where it is out of lexical scope.
Use byte-exact source from tool reads in edit search blocks; never include rendered line-number prefixes.
All existing tests must remain green.
